# Ishikawa for support

`customer_support.df.root_cause_analysis.ishikawa_for_support` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **decision_framework**

> Ishikawa / fishbone, with support-native categories — product defect, data, configuration, environment, third party, documentation, process, and expectation.

Its job is breadth before depth, forcing categories nobody would have volunteered. The last two categories matter disproportionately here: a large share of support "faults" are the product working as designed against a customer who was told otherwise, and no engineering RCA template has a place to put that.
